en_title: Wardogs Dev Says PS6 and Xbox Project Helix Ports Should Be Relatively Straightforward
subtitle: 目标次世代
opus_summary: 《Wardogs》团队称，移植至次世代主机预计无需太多额外工作，目前已与平台方沟通。游戏计划于2028年登陆主机，PC版正处于抢先体验阶段。

paragraphs.en: The team behind Wardogs expects to bring the game to next-gen consoles in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 《战狗》开发团队预计，未来会将这款游戏带到次世代主机。

paragraphs.en: Although some would argue that this console generation has yet to meet its full potential, platform holders are already ramping up for the next one with Sony's PlayStation 6 and Xbox's Project Helix, though neither company has locked in an official release window. However, it does mean some developers have to start planning ahead, and one of those studios is Bulkhead, the team behind the new shooter Wardogs.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管有人认为本世代主机的潜力还未完全发挥，平台方已经在加紧筹备下一代硬件，包括索尼的PS6和XBOX的Project Helix，不过两家公司都尚未正式确定发售时间范围。一些开发商也因此必须开始提前规划，新射击游戏《战狗》的开发商Bulkhead就是其中之一。

paragraphs.en: In an exclusive interview with IGN, we talked about plans for the game's eventual console release. Wardogs is currently slated to make the jump to consoles in 2028 , which begs the question: Will it release on next-gen hardware? Bulkhead says it's not even really a question.
paragraphs.cn: 在IGN的独家采访中，我们聊到了这款游戏未来登陆主机的计划。《战狗》目前计划于2028年登陆主机，这不免让人问：它会登陆次世代硬件吗？Bulkhead表示，这其实根本算不上一个问题。

paragraphs.en: "I think there's not too much to consider," said Bulkhead co-founder Howard Philpott. "We make the game performant, we're going to get it on the next-gen consoles. From our perspective, it's a straight port. So yeah, absolutely is the short answer, to be honest."
paragraphs.cn: Bulkhead联合创始人Howard Philpott说：「我觉得没太多需要考虑的。我们把游戏性能做好，就会把它带到次世代主机上。从我们的角度来看，直接移植就行。所以坦白说，简短的回答就是：没错，当然会。」

paragraphs.en: Senior producer Kane Allard noted that Bulkhead is already speaking with platform holders about the console versions of Wardogs, and doesn't anticipate any issues bringing the game to next-gen machines.
paragraphs.cn: 高级制作人Kane Allard指出，Bulkhead已经在与平台方商谈《战狗》的主机版本，预计将游戏带到次世代主机上不会遇到什么问题。

paragraphs.en: "We're obviously already in conversation with the proprietors of those platforms, and they're going to have certain criteria that we have to match, and I assume it's going to be the same for those other consoles as well. So from our perspective, if we get it on a base Xbox or base PlayStation, it shouldn't be much more work to get it on next-gen, and it should just be more performance. So I don't think it gives us anything new."
paragraphs.cn: 「我们当然已经在与这些平台的持有方沟通，他们会提出一些我们必须达到的标准，我想其他那些主机也会如此。所以从我们的角度来看，如果我们能让游戏在标准版XBOX或标准版PlayStation上运行，把它带到次世代主机上应该也不需要多做多少工作，性能应该只会更好。所以我不认为这会给我们带来什么新的问题。」

paragraphs.en: Last month, former PlayStation Worldwide Studios boss Shuhei Yoshida said Sony and Nintendo should make their current consoles last as long as possible amid soaring costs that have already prompted PS5 and Switch 2 price rises. Yoshida told The Verge that console companies needed to focus on sustaining their current hardware platforms for "as long as possible."
paragraphs.cn: 上个月，前PlayStation全球工作室负责人吉田修平表示，成本飙升已经导致PS5和Switch 2涨价，索尼和任天堂应尽可能延长现有主机的生命周期。吉田向The Verge表示，主机厂商需要把重点放在「尽可能长时间」维持现有硬件平台上。

paragraphs.en: We know that a PS6 is on the way at some point . Previously, analysts had suggested a 2028 launch seemed likely, though Sony is yet to make any official indication of when PS6 may arrive — and as time goes on, that late 2028 release date feels less and less likely .
paragraphs.cn: 我们知道，PS6迟早会到来。此前，分析师认为它很可能在2028年推出，但索尼尚未正式透露PS6可能何时问世。而随着时间推移，2028年末发售的可能性似乎越来越小。

paragraphs.en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has insisted Project Helix remains part of Microsoft's gaming plan, but has also said next-gen Xbox hardware will be a "family of devices." "We are moving to a family of devices for Gen-10," she said in a memo reported by Windows Central . "There is not one device that fits all. We will certainly have a great console first, but we also know that many players will be on the go. There are some things that we are the best in the world to manufacture, and there are other things that will we partner on. So, we will be sharing more about that as our plans develop. The operating system is starting to look really good. We're very excited about this."
paragraphs.cn: XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma强调，Project Helix仍是微软游戏计划的一部分，但她也表示，下一代XBOX硬件将是一个「设备家族」。据Windows Central报道，她在一份备忘录中说：「第十世代，我们将转向设备家族。没有一款设备能满足所有人的需求。我们首先当然会推出一款出色的主机，但我们也知道，许多玩家会在外出时玩游戏。有些产品我们拥有世界顶尖的制造能力，另一些则会与合作伙伴共同打造。因此，随着计划推进，我们会分享更多相关信息。操作系统已经开始展现出很不错的样貌。我们对此非常兴奋。」

paragraphs.en: For now, anyone looking to play Wardogs will have to check out the PC version, which is currently in early access. Next week sees the launch of Season 2 , which will introduce major gameplay features such as rain.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，想玩《战狗》的玩家还得选择PC版，该版本正处于抢先体验阶段。第二赛季将于下周上线，加入降雨等重要玩法功能。
